spots.name: Peace Arch International Monument
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Boundary Bay Wildlife Management Area
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Sumas Creek at Kneuman Road
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 97 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L13115294.

spots.name: Judson Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings.
